headline: **MLB Daily Recap**
article:
The Los Angeles Angels fell to the Baltimore Orioles 3-1, with Tyler O'Neill hitting his eighth home run of the season. The New York Mets secured a 6-2 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, led by Luis Torrens' 3-hit, 4-RBI performance. The Cincinnati Reds edged the Athletics 5-4 in a thrilling finish, with Julian Garcia earning the win.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including James Wood, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left oblique strain with the Washington Nationals. The Athletics have also placed Jeffrey Springs on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 1, 2026, with right hip discomfort, and Nick Kurtz on the 10-day injured list retroactive to August 1, 2026, with a strained right thumb.

The Oakland Athletics have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of right-handed pitcher Seth Johnson, acquired in a trade with the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for outfielder Colby Thomas.

top_news.title: **Angels Fall Short in Baltimore**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels dropped a 3-1 decision to the Baltimore Orioles, failing to capitalize on a strong outing from their pitching staff. Tyler O'Neill led the Orioles' offense with a solo home run, his eighth of the season.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Guardians 6-2**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a 6-2 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Sean Manaea earning the win after 6.0 innings pitched. Luis Torrens led the Mets' offense with a 3-hit, 4-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Reds Edge Athletics in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 5-4 victory over the Athletics, with Julian Garcia earning the win. Brady Singer led the Athletics' pitching effort, throwing 6.0 innings with 6 strikeouts.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall to Phillies in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals were defeated by the Philadelphia Phillies with a final score of 5-0. Jesús Luzardo led the Phillies to victory, pitching 8.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Nationals' James Wood Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Washington Nationals right fielder James Wood has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left oblique strain.

top_news.title: **Athletics Acquire RHP Seth Johnson in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of right-handed pitcher Seth Johnson, acquired in a trade with the Philadelphia Phillies. Johnson joins the Athletics in exchange for outfielder Colby Thomas.
